S1_stand.fixture: Sonic lands on EEZ3 cell (36,26), invincibility selector 6, no input, 700 updates.

S2_offscreen_return.fixture: Fire button 0 (u~17), park Sonic at WORLD(200,400) u120..1019 (button 0 ~1000px offscreen), return u1020, step on fresh button 1 at u1420.

S3_bolt_asleep.fixture: Fire button 0, move Sonic+camera away 3 updates after allocation for 500 updates, then return to the same cell.

S4_reload.fixture: Fire button 0, run right over buttons 1..6 and into the pit; invincibility off from u80.

static.note: Immediate-operand scan: the only LD C,$B2 followed by CALL $6BD4 is surface $0B at $6BAF. $6BD4 stores C to the probed layout cell ($D354) and redraws it.

contract.chain: terrain floor pass -> surface $0B handler $6BAA (needs floor bit1 $D522) -> $6BAF C=$B2, $6BD4: layout cell (*$D354)=$B2 and nametable redraw -> $5E9C (16-slot) type $37 parameter 1 -> init $1E:$8ED0 state3 at cell X+15, Y=cell+24-120 (act index 2) -> state3 $8F43 falls +4.25 and hurts while at/before cellY-24 -> state2 dissipate -> delete.
contract.q1: No. Nothing re-arms. The cell stays $B2 until the act layout is re-decoded by the level loader ($4DAE..$4DFB) on death/restart/reload.
contract.q2: Not applicable (no callback count or event restores $B1). Only level (re)load resets it.
contract.q3: No visible reset: $B2 is written once and redrawn once; the button stays in its changed art.
contract.q4: Local to each layout cell. EEZ3 has seven $B1 cells at row 26, x=36,38,...,48; each fires independently and once. Shared state is only the object pool and scratch $D35C/$D35E/$D354.
contract.q5: One firing only: the handler runs with floor bit1 once, rewrites the cell, and later frames probe $B2, so the handler is not entered. Standing for 700 updates gives one allocation.
contract.q6: No. Reset is not object-owned. The bolt is a normal object and is removed by generic offscreen lifecycle if the camera leaves (the cell stays $B2), and the cell persists through 1000 offscreen updates.

method:
EEZ3 floor button (surface $0B, cell $B1->$B2) and the type-$37 parameter-1 cannon bolt.

Whole-game fixtures run original scheduler/player/terrain/object code from the zone5 act3
snapshot. Fixture writes are Sonic's placement, invincibility selector $D532=6 (so contact
cannot knock him off the button), camera/park position (to force offscreen sleep) and, in the
reload case, a pit position. The layout cell is only observed, never written.
